tools.name: add_packing_items
tools.description: Adds up to 100 user-accepted packing items as separate cards. Items are private to the user by default; shared=true adds the whole batch to the party’s shared list. All new items are unpacked. The operation creates additions rather than reconciling duplicates with existing cards. Returns card IDs, individual change eventIds, revision and the number added.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

assigneeId.description: Shared items only: the existing trip member ID of the person bringing the item.

bag.description: Which bag, if the user says, for example "Carry-on".

category.description: One of documents, clothes, shoes, toiletries, health, electronics, gear, beach, kids, food, or a free-text group. Guessed from the title if left out.

title.description: What to bring, for example "Sunscreen" or "Passport".

toBuy.description: Still to be bought before the trip.

shared.description: Whether every item in this batch belongs to the party’s shared list instead of the user’s private list. One batch has one visibility.

tools.name: add_trip_ideas
tools.description: Saves up to 24 user-accepted public ideas as one reversible batch, with optional verified place photos and map points. A day without planned=true is a suggestion; planned=true represents the user’s decision to add it to the plan. Neither state creates a reservation. Secret proposals are not supported. Returns saved IDs, individual change eventIds, revision and a link to the ideas or day.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

items.description: Up to 24 sourced ideas. Suggestions are not bookings. No private, payment or reservation data.

placeSource.description: Optional exact English Wikipedia article URL for the researched place, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Article. Awayfolk verifies the article’s coordinates and licensed photograph. Image URLs are not accepted as sources.

tools.name: cancel_surprise
tools.description: Removes an unrevealed card-scoped surprise that has no remaining organizers, when its current canCancelSurprise capability permits it. The trip owner receives no secret content. This removes the trip card only, not any supplier booking, and returns only a change receipt.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Creates a new invitation link for the user to share with their travel party. A person who signs in and accepts can join as a traveller, see shared cards, add and change them, and invite others. Joining is subject to the trip’s current access and membership limits. Each call creates a distinct link that expires after 30 days. This operation shares access and is not idempotent.

tools.name: create_trip
tools.description: Creates a shared travel workspace from a name. Destination, dates and preferences may be left unset. Requires explicit permission to create trips. The template can add starter ideas; these are not bookings. Returns the trip ID and revision.

accent.description: Trip colour as a hex code, for example #2F5E8C.

endDate.description: Optional return date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty startDate and endDate clear future dates when no dated cards remain.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

lang.description: The travellers’ language for the template’s starter cards: en (default) or nb for Norwegian.

modules.description: Which parts of the workspace the travellers use: ideas, plan, map, today, packing, bookings, money. Omission retains the current selection. Hidden modules keep their existing cards.

mystery.description: Blåtur (mystery trip): a few planners plan a surprise for the other travellers. Only the owner makes a trip a blåtur and only planners change it; null turns it off and reveals only trip-scoped secrets. Independent card-scoped surprises retain their permissions. A field left out keeps its value.

clues.description: The complete list of clues with their IDs; replaces the earlier list.

at.description: When it unlocks, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM at the destination. Omission makes it visible immediately.

text.description: A non-secret hint for travellers, for example "Pack swimwear".

hideDestination.description: Whether the destination is hidden from travellers until the reveal.

planners.description: Existing trip member IDs for planners who are in on the surprise, besides the owner.

reveal.description: When the destination is revealed: when the trip starts, at a set time, or only when a planner reveals it.

at.description: For mode time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM at the destination.

startDate.description: Optional departure date as YYYY-MM-DD. Dates are either both unset or an ordered pair.

styles.description: Optional, combinable trip styles. These describe the trip without changing its modules or adding cards.

template.description: A shape to start from, on create only: chooses modules and a few starter cards; mystery starts a blåtur with the destination kept secret. Ignored when updating. The example trips on awayfolk.app are for ideas, not templates.

timezone.description: Required when first setting trip dates. IANA time zone of the destination, for example Europe/Rome for Rome or America/Cancun for Tulum. Every time on the trip’s cards is local to it.

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Removes a visible card from the active trip into recoverable Trash. It does not cancel an external booking or refund a payment. Later edits and access restrictions can prevent removal.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns a permitted search result in full: a trip identified by trip:<tripId> or one card identified by record:<tripId>:<recordId>. Includes text, URL and metadata with the current trip revision.

id.description: A result ID: trip:<tripId> or record:<tripId>:<recordId>.

tools.name: get_my_travel_profile
tools.description: Reads only the authenticated person’s explicitly saved travel frequency, pace and interests, and only while they enable AI sharing in their profile. These are optional personal preferences, not facts about the whole group or permission to change a trip. Null or empty values mean unspecified. Other travellers’ profiles, legacy free-text notes and inferred preferences are not included. This tool cannot edit preferences or enable sharing. Sharing is off by default and controlled by the person in Profile.

tools.name: get_travel_choices
tools.description: Lists authorised comparison summaries, or up to five current offers in one exact comparison per revision-bound page. The selected immutable version is separate from current proposals. Returns actor, trip and group revisions, audience and proposal capability; excludes version history and supplier confirmation references. This reads saved research, not live availability.

groupId.description: Exact comparison ID from the summary read or its Awayfolk link. Omission lists authorised summaries.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same comparison and unchanged revision. Omission starts its current offers.

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Returns a permitted trip, travel preferences, visible records, participants and current revision. financialPeople is a separate list of named expense participants, not trip members or access grants; a memberId explicitly associates their existing shares with that account. People are added and linked in the app. Ideas include read-only interest.memberIds for people who marked that they want to go; these wishes are set by the people themselves on the website. Activity surprises, mystery-trip secrets and other people’s private records are excluded according to the caller’s current access. Card capabilities describe allowed actions; trip ownership alone grants no access to a card-scoped surprise.

tools.name: get_trip_decisions
tools.description: Returns the permitted trip’s separate destination and date polls, alternatives, participant responses, counts and current poll revisions. Unanswered is distinct from No. Hidden mystery destinations are visible only to authorized planners. Full trip membership and this AI connection’s trip grant are required; poll-only participation provides no AI access.

tools.name: hand_over_trip
tools.description: Transfers trip ownership to an existing member. Only the current owner can perform the transfer; a mystery trip requires the recipient to be a planner. The new owner controls invitations and member removal. The former owner remains a traveller and cannot unilaterally reverse the transfer.

memberId.description: The new owner’s existing trip member ID.

tools.name: leave_trip
tools.description: Removes the authenticated user from the trip and withdraws this AI connection’s access to it. Shared cards remain for other travellers; a later invitation can restore membership. The owner cannot leave while still owning the trip.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Returns the trip change feed visible to this user, including agent edits. Actions member.join, member.leave, member.remove and member.owner concern people; title is that person’s first name. Reading does not mark notifications read. nextCursor is the beforeRevision value for the next page.

tools.name: list_my_changes
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user’s recent changes to a permitted trip.

tools.name: list_trash
tools.description: Lists recoverable shared cards and the user’s own private cards. nextCursor is the beforeRevision value for the next page.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.description: Lists trips permitted for this AI connection: all trips the user belongs to, or only their selected trips when access has been narrowed in Awayfolk.

tools.name: propose_travel_offer
tools.description: Creates a comparison with one offer, adds an offer to an exact comparison, updates an exact current authored quote, or completes an exact authorised saved source. Proposals retain original-currency estimates and explicit coverage; absent facts remain unknown. Required actor, revisions and audience bind the proposal to its reviewed context. Returns a comparison link. This does not answer, select, confirm, book, pay, reveal, adopt records or change actual prices; no external lookup occurs.

groupId.description: Exact existing comparison ID; omission creates one comparison and its first offer atomically.

groupTitle.description: Required only when creating a comparison.

purpose.description: Optional creation-only purpose, for example Return travel or Accommodation.

visibility.description: Creation-only ownership. Personal visibility is additional to the required audience, not a secrecy substitute.

offerId.description: Exact current authored quote to update, or authorised saved link/idea to complete; omission appends a new offer.

expectedVersionId.description: Required current version ID when updating or completing an existing offer.

expectedSourceRevision.description: Required current original-card revision when completing a source-backed idea.

expectedActor.description: Captured actorId from the current comparison read; rejects account replacement.

expectedTripRevision.description: Current tripRevision from the comparison read.

expectedRevision.description: Required current group revision for an existing comparison.

audience.description: Explicit audience. Planners requires current mystery-planner authority and manual planner secrecy; a private refusal cannot become a trip-audience fallback.

stage.description: Link retains only a source; quote contains researched parts and estimates. Omission means quote.

sourceUrl.description: Exact public HTTPS source including its query and fragment; stored without fetching. Empty means unknown.

observedAt.description: Actual observation time in epoch milliseconds, or null/omitted when unknown. Not a live availability claim.

parts.description: Empty for link stage; quote requires 1–12 parts. Unknown endpoints stay unknown.

id.description: Unique local ID beginning with a letter or digit; remaining characters are letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

day.description: Known real YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string when unknown.

time.description: Known local HH:MM, or an empty string when unknown.

endTime.description: Known local HH:MM, or an empty string when unknown.

endDay.description: Known real YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string when unknown.

startTimezone.description: Known IANA departure/check-in zone, or empty; never inferred from trip defaults.

endTimezone.description: Known IANA arrival/check-out zone, or empty.

url.description: Exact public HTTPS source including its query and fragment; stored without fetching. Empty means unknown.

units.description: Explicit tickets, rooms or other distinct coverage units; at most 100 across the offer. IDs are unique across parts, units and prices.

id.description: Unique local ID beginning with a letter or digit; remaining characters are letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

prices.description: Empty for link stage. Each covered unit appears in at most one price; omitted coverage stays unpriced.

id.description: Unique local ID beginning with a letter or digit; remaining characters are letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

items.description: Unique local ID beginning with a letter or digit; remaining characters are letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

cost.description: Estimated original-currency total for exactly the listed coverage units, or null when unknown. No per-person conversion, payment or supplier verification.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical proposal; identical uncertain retries retain all arguments and this key.

tools.name: propose_trip_option
tools.description: Adds one user-requested destination or date alternative to an open poll. Optional manual prices retain their source and a server timestamp; unknown prices remain unknown. The expected revision belongs to the selected poll. Returns the new option ID and poll revision. This addition casts no vote, confirms no choice, changes no membership and creates no booking. Existing alternatives and their responses remain unchanged.

endDate.description: Required for a date option: actual last date as YYYY-MM-DD.

expectedRevision.description: Revision of the destination or dates poll, not the trip revision. Returned by the decision read or preceding proposal.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

name.description: Freeform destination or travel idea, such as Copenhagen by ferry. Required for a destination option; coordinates are not required.

price.description: Optional manual price per person in major currency units. Missing or null means unknown; the server records when it was added.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the supplied amount.

source.description: Source of this price, such as its public source URL or the user who supplied it.

reason.description: Brief reason this option suits the group.

startDate.description: Required for a date option: actual first date as YYYY-MM-DD.

travelMinutes.description: Optional sourced or user-provided travel time in minutes.

url.description: Optional public HTTPS source or travel link; stored without fetching it.

tools.name: render_trip
tools.description: Returns an interactive view and text result for the permitted trip’s ideas and day plan. Optional public suggestions are previews, not saved records; the view can save them as public ideas after user selection. An exact placeSource Wikipedia article supports verified coordinates and licensed photographs through external lookups; unavailable sources leave usable text cards. Saved secret cards follow their current per-card or mystery-trip permissions, including when the trip destination is public. Preview suggestions do not support secret content.

suggestions.description: Up to 24 sourced ideas. Suggestions are not bookings. No private, payment or reservation data.

placeSource.description: Optional exact English Wikipedia article URL for the researched place, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Article. Awayfolk verifies the article’s coordinates and licensed photograph. Image URLs are not accepted as sources.

tools.name: restore_record
tools.description: Restores a removed card without overwriting subsequent edits. Requires the applicable trip revision, dates that still fit the trip, and any linked packing or activity records to be present. Returns the restored card ID, revision and change event ID.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

tools.name: reveal_record
tools.description: Reveals one existing card-scoped surprise to the trip’s members when its current canReveal capability permits it. This publishes the card’s details; already viewed information cannot be made unseen. The operation accepts no content changes and returns only a change receipt.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

tools.name: save_link
tools.description: Fetches a user-shared HTTPS page and saves a public trip idea with its title, description, place and date. The page may provide an event, restaurant, place, Google Maps place or article. A discovered picture is added when a traveller next opens Ideas. Instagram content may be unavailable. The idea is suggested for a day when the page date fits the trip or the user supplies day. This tool cannot save secrets and never makes a booking. Returns the saved card receipt and preview details.

category.description: Only to override what the page says. restaurant = eating out (restaurant, café, bakery); cooking = a meal the travellers make themselves, usually from a recipe link; nightlife = bars, pubs, clubs, après-ski; experience = an event at a set date and time, usually ticketed (concert, festival, match, show); activity = something organised, rented or booked (tour, boat trip, ski day, class); culture = museums, galleries, churches, landmarks; shopping = markets and shops worth a visit (not shopping lists); nature = hikes, beaches, viewpoints, parks, lakes; place = any other named place (a town, a neighbourhood, a meeting point, a blåtur stop); stay = somewhere to sleep that is still being considered; downtime = time at the base (movie night, board games, sauna, a rest day).

day.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, only when the user has said which day.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

notes.description: Why it suits them, in the user’s words. Defaults to the page’s description.

title.description: Only when the page’s own title is poor.

tools.name: save_record
tools.description: Adds or updates an idea, planned activity, booking, personal or shared packing item, shared checklist task, outfit, shared expense or repayment. The retired memory kind is only for a historical paid trip whose trip.access.memoryWrite is true; never suggest it as a new trip feature. Only the creator edits or deletes idea/activity content; any permitted member may change their day, time, endTime or status to plan, move or unplan them. Record capabilities canEditContent and canPlan describe these permissions, including for the trip owner. A new card-scoped surprise is secret from its first save; existing public cards cannot be converted. The creator controls its content and organizer list; permitted organizers can plan and reveal without general content editing. recordId selects an update; omitted day and data fields retain their values, while an empty string or null clears supported fields. Financial edits require the complete expense or settlement object. Dates of plans and bookings must fit the trip. A card with a day and status idea remains a suggestion; planned represents a chosen day, not a booking or unanimous group approval. Confirmed bookings and paid costs represent user-confirmed facts. Historical archive entries must describe experiences the user confirms actually happened. Shared expenses and repayments require user confirmation of an actual purchase or payment; their date is inside the financial object and day is empty. This tool records information, never books, pays or cancels with a supplier. Optional place resolution uses external geocoding. Returns the card ID, revision and change event ID.

activityId.description: ID of an existing idea, activity or booking on this trip linked to the outfit.

arrivalPlace.description: Flight: the arrival airport code, for example CUN. Other bookings: where it ends.

assigneeId.description: An existing trip member ID; empty means unassigned. Personal packing can only be assigned to the authenticated user.

boughtQuantity.description: Packing: how many of the units to buy are bought; at most the number to buy.

category.description: Ideas and activities: one of restaurant, cooking, nightlife, experience, activity, culture, shopping, nature, place, stay, downtime. restaurant = eating out (restaurant, café, bakery); cooking = a meal the travellers make themselves, usually from a recipe link; nightlife = bars, pubs, clubs, après-ski; experience = an event at a set date and time, usually ticketed (concert, festival, match, show); activity = something organised, rented or booked (tour, boat trip, ski day, class); culture = museums, galleries, churches, landmarks; shopping = markets and shops worth a visit (not shopping lists); nature = hikes, beaches, viewpoints, parks, lakes; place = any other named place (a town, a neighbourhood, a meeting point, a blåtur stop); stay = somewhere to sleep that is still being considered; downtime = time at the base (movie night, board games, sauna, a rest day). Packing items: one of documents, clothes, shoes, toiletries, health, electronics, gear, beach, kids, food, or a free-text group of your own.

checkInHours.description: User-verified check-in opening hours before flight departure; omitted when unknown.

amountMinor.description: Amount in minor units (NOK cents, JPY whole yen). Omitted or null means unknown; zero means free.

endDay.description: Arrival, check-out or end date as YYYY-MM-DD.

example.description: Whether the card was copied from an example trip.

expense.description: A user-confirmed actual shared purchase. The enclosing card’s day is empty; date is inside this object. Planned prices belong to the separate cost field.

amountMinor.description: Positive amount in the currency’s smallest unit, for example øre for NOK or whole yen for JPY.

currency.description: Supported ISO currency code. Each currency has a separate ledger without inferred exchange rates.

date.description: Actual purchase date as YYYY-MM-DD, which may be before or after the trip.

paidBy.description: Current member ID or active financialPeople ID of the person who actually paid. Named financial people are added in the app; they are not trip members.

amountMinor.description: Required for exact splits; the shares must sum to amountMinor. Equal splits are recalculated by the server.

memberId.description: Current member ID or active financialPeople ID in the trip result. Existing expenses retain their raw IDs and saved shares unless their allocation is explicitly changed.

imageUrl.description: Read-only pending picture from a shared link. A traveller’s browser adds it; this tool cannot set the URL.

location.description: Verified map point. When absent, eligible cards can be geocoded near the trip’s destination; unchanged places retain existing pins. Clearing a pin is available on the website.

source.description: osm and geoapify are read-only provenance: echoed values retain the existing source only for the same saved coordinates; a new point is marked agent.

mediaId.description: Existing photo ID. New photo uploads are available on the website.

mediaIds.description: Complete ordered list of existing photo IDs, at most 8. The first is the cover. When provided, replaces the earlier list, including an empty array. New photo uploads are available on the website.

packedQuantity.description: Number packed, at most quantity. Takes precedence over legacy packed boolean.

placeAttribution.description: Read-only provider credit from saved place discovery. Echoed values are ignored and existing provenance is retained.

placeRef.description: Read-only saved place identity. Echoed values are accepted but ignored; only the website establishes provider identity.

placeSource.description: Optional exact English Wikipedia article URL for the researched place, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Article. Awayfolk verifies the article’s coordinates and licensed photograph. Image URLs are not accepted as sources.

practical.description: Public practical information retained after an activity surprise opens. Only the content creator may edit it.

purchaseQuantity.description: How many packing units need purchase; at most quantity.

reservation.description: Server-owned reservation on this exact idea or activity. An unchanged echo is accepted; omission retains it. General card edits cannot change or remove it.

arrangedBy.description: Current trip member explicitly responsible for arranging this booking, or null when unknown. Independent of the payer and the person recording it.

url.description: Optional public HTTPS confirmation link, stored without fetching it. No credentials or private contact/payment details.

revealed.description: Read-only: this card was a surprise that has opened. Ignored on input.

secret.description: A new scope card surprise is supported only for idea or activity records and is independent of the trip destination and visible only to its creator and chosen organizers until revealed. Existing public cards cannot become card surprises. Omission retains the setting. Without scope, the established mystery-trip rules apply: null reveals it, and flights or stays default to secret while the destination is hidden.

at.description: For reveal time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM at the destination.

organizerIds.description: Current trip member IDs selected to know this card. The server includes the authenticated creator; only that creator changes this list.

practical.description: Optional public practical information, such as meeting point, equipment or agreed contribution. Nothing is copied from private card details.

reveal.description: When the card opens: manual by default for scope card, a chosen time, or its start. Legacy trip-scoped secrets default to start.

scope.description: Independent secrecy for one new card, without changing the trip or revealing it to the trip owner.

teaser.description: Optional public hint in the group’s own words. Visible to surprised travellers.

settlement.description: A user-confirmed repayment already made outside Awayfolk, for example with Vipps. This records a payment; it never sends money. The enclosing card’s day is empty.

amountMinor.description: Positive amount in the currency’s smallest unit, for example øre for NOK or whole yen for JPY.

date.description: Actual repayment date as YYYY-MM-DD, which may be after the trip.

from.description: Current or historical member or financialPeople ID who actually sent the money. New payments require financialPeople.memberId when present, including a former traveller; linked alias IDs are rejected. Original endpoint IDs remain valid on an existing payment.

to.description: Different member or financialPeople ID who actually received the money. Historical participants in this trip’s ledger are allowed. New payments require financialPeople.memberId when present; linked alias IDs are rejected. A financialPeople association does not change past payment IDs.

visibility.description: Packing only: personal by default. Shared items are visible/editable by all trip members. Set at creation and immutable afterward.

day.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD within the trip; empty for expenses and repayments.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

tools.name: save_reservation
tools.description: Records, corrects or removes external booking information on one existing visible idea or activity when its canReserve capability permits it. The same card, planning state, price and actual expenses are retained. One confirmation covers this activity only. Status describes a user-confirmed supplier fact; cancelled records a cancellation already made outside Awayfolk. A null reservation removes only these local details. Empty provider, reference or URL and an unknown arranger are valid. Ordinary corrections preserve the originally recorded plan; confirmSchedule=true explicitly attests that the supplier booking matches the current card. Returns a change receipt and card link. This operation never books, pays or cancels with a supplier.

confirmSchedule.description: True only for user-confirmed agreement between the external booking and the current title, place and schedule. Omission preserves the previous snapshot.

expectedRevision.description: Trip revision on which this change is based. A successful write returns the revision for subsequent changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

arrangedBy.description: Current trip member explicitly responsible for arranging this booking, or null when unknown. Independent of the payer and the person recording it.

url.description: Optional public HTTPS confirmation link, stored without fetching it. No credentials or private contact/payment details.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Finds permitted trips and cards by words in titles, places, notes or dates (YYYY-MM-DD). An empty query lists the permitted trips. Returns result IDs, titles and URLs.

query.description: Words to look for. Empty lists the shared trips.

tools.name: set_packed
tools.description: Updates packed or bought quantities on the user’s own packing list or the shared list. The supplied quantities represent what the user has confirmed packing or buying. Other travellers’ private lists are inaccessible. Does not change the trip revision.

bought.description: For things to buy: how many are bought.

packed.description: How many of the card’s quantity are packed: the full quantity when done, 0 to unpack.

recordId.description: An existing visible packing card ID.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.description: Reverses a change made by this user only when no later edit, including their own, has changed the card and its dates still fit the trip. eventId identifies one change; eventIds identifies a batch of card additions. Batch cards changed since the addition remain in place and are reported in kept.

eventIds.description: The complete set of change event IDs returned by one batch addition.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

tools.name: update_trip
tools.description: Updates a permitted trip’s travel profile, dates, theme and mystery settings. Omitted optional fields retain their values. expectedRevision identifies the version on which the update is based; conflicting changes are refused. Mystery settings remain subject to owner and planner permissions.

accent.description: Trip colour as a hex code, for example #2F5E8C.

endDate.description: Optional return date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty startDate and endDate clear future dates when no dated cards remain.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical change; an identical retry uses the same key.

modules.description: Which parts of the workspace the travellers use: ideas, plan, map, today, packing, bookings, money. Omission retains the current selection. Hidden modules keep their existing cards.

mystery.description: Blåtur (mystery trip): a few planners plan a surprise for the other travellers. Only the owner makes a trip a blåtur and only planners change it; null turns it off and reveals only trip-scoped secrets. Independent card-scoped surprises retain their permissions. A field left out keeps its value.

clues.description: The complete list of clues with their IDs; replaces the earlier list.

at.description: When it unlocks, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM at the destination. Omission makes it visible immediately.

text.description: A non-secret hint for travellers, for example "Pack swimwear".

hideDestination.description: Whether the destination is hidden from travellers until the reveal.

planners.description: Existing trip member IDs for planners who are in on the surprise, besides the owner.

reveal.description: When the destination is revealed: when the trip starts, at a set time, or only when a planner reveals it.

at.description: For mode time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM at the destination.

startDate.description: Optional departure date as YYYY-MM-DD. Dates are either both unset or an ordered pair.

styles.description: Optional, combinable trip styles. These describe the trip without changing its modules or adding cards.

template.description: A shape to start from, on create only: chooses modules and a few starter cards; mystery starts a blåtur with the destination kept secret. Ignored when updating. The example trips on awayfolk.app are for ideas, not templates.

timezone.description: Required when first setting trip dates. IANA time zone of the destination, for example Europe/Rome for Rome or America/Cancun for Tulum. Every time on the trip’s cards is local to it.
